title: Singular stationary Navier-Stokes flows: examples and stability
summary: Landau solutions, when oriented along the vertical axis, represent a one parameter family of exact, self-similar, axisymmetric, swirl-free solutions to the 3D stationary Navier-Stokes equations forced by an upward facing point-source of momentum at the origin. They have an isolated singularity at the origin. Other singular steady state solutions can be derived from a similar framework. Some of these variants have been proposed as models for physical scenarios.
